gates.name: Precise theorem-shaped statement
gates.question: Can the candidate be stated as a formula, law, or divergence rather than a visual impression?

gates.name: Exact finite-field interpretation
gates.question: Is there an exact F_q[t] object or known algebraic mechanism on the theorem side?

gates.name: Integer-prime holdout evidence
gates.question: Was an integer-prime analogue preregistered and checked on unseen ranges?

gates.name: Local/null/random controls
gates.question: Does the candidate beat local baselines, random controls, and known leakage/placebo tests?

gates.name: Compression / low parameter count
gates.question: Is the rule simpler than the data and not explained by tuning many fitted knobs?

gates.name: Scale and field stability
gates.question: Does the result survive changes in degree, q, range, or normalization?

gates.name: Novelty audit
gates.question: Is it not just a renamed known theorem, local obstruction, or plotting artifact?

gates.name: Reproducible code, logs, plots
gates.question: Are the scripts, raw JSON/MD artifacts, and evidence pack present?

gates.name: Plausible proof path
gates.question: Can the result be organized into definitions, finite-field proposition, integer analogue, and obstruction/conjecture?

gates.name: Expert-ready evidence pack

precise_statement.evidence: Candidate states Z_AB=sum_lambda (X_A-1/3)(X_B-1/3)/sqrt(|labels|*4/81) across low-conductor cubic Kummer cover families.

finite_field_anchor.evidence: F_q[t] side is exact: A(t) ranges over low-degree squarefree polynomials, P ranges over monic irreducibles, and X_A(P) is cube-residue splitting in F_q[t]/P.

integer_holdout.evidence: Integer side checks the preregistered ladder 1000000, 2000000, 4000000, 8000000 through N=8000000.

controls.evidence: No matched anomaly survives: allWithinControls=true, integerWithinControls=true, fieldsWithinControls=true.

compression.evidence: Low-parameter statistic: one centered covariance formula over fixed low-conductor cover families and preregistered control envelopes.

scale_stability.evidence: Scale gate requires complete integer/field ladders and matched control survival. Integer ladder=true; field ladders=true; matched control survival=false; profileAligned=false.

novelty_audit.evidence: The run is a genuine family-level mutation, but the observed covariance is explained by standard Chebotarev/Kummer independence and stays inside controls.

reproducibility.evidence: JSON/MD/SVG/script artifacts are present for the full 8M and q=2,5,7 run.

proof_path.evidence: There is no anomaly to prove; the natural proof path is the known equidistribution/null statement, not a new integer-prime breakthrough.

expert_pack.evidence: No expert-ready breakthrough pack exists because controls, scale stability, novelty, and proof-path gates fail.

theoremShape.integer: A ranges over low-conductor constants c and labels are rational primes p == 1 mod 3; X_c(p)=1 when c is a cubic residue mod p
theoremShape.functionField: A ranges over low-degree squarefree polynomials A(t) and labels are monic irreducibles P with mu_3 in F_q[t]/P; X_A(P)=1 when A(t) is a cube modulo P
theoremShape.baseline: independent cubic Kummer characters give E[split]=1/3 and E[(X_A-1/3)(X_B-1/3)]=0 for unrelated covers

preregisteredNextMove: Do not add more Kummer/Chebotarev cover counts or covariance matrices without a named theorem target that is not an equidistribution calibration.
Move only to a genuinely different domain/object, or to a proof-first lemma smaller than a famous open conjecture.
Before data, name the exact finite-field theorem mechanism, the integer-prime analogue, local/null controls, complete holdout ladders, novelty audit, proof path, and expert-pack criteria.
